author: Veli Raiya (@veliraiyawrites)
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content:
Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both.

Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂

See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍

For character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art. Open to different styles. Bonus for POC and variety of ethnicities.
For the map: detailed and immersive with classic fantasy-map feel. Contact via Threads replies/DMs.
